say: Most store bought coffee leaves you feeling drained.

why:
Series 1 Subscribe & Save addresses the common frustration of weak supermarket coffee using the high-engagement opening mechanic of viral coffee ritual videos (8.5M+ views). It drives direct customer inquiries via WhatsApp for subscription setup.
Some shots come from a viral video in your niche (21.5M views) to boost reach; your product and call to action open and close the video.

problems: WhatsApp CTA makes no sense for a major US e-commerce brand like Death Wish Coffee
Generic stock footage throughout; no branded Death Wish packaging or products shown
Three repetitive pouring shots in a row (0:03-0:08)
qa.fix: Feature real Death Wish Coffee packaging and beans, cut the repetitive pouring b-roll, and update the CTA to direct viewers to the website instead of WhatsApp.
